text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It's undeniable now. I was being 
complacent.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I thought I had grown strong. In reality, 
though... I was still weak.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
For there is no fool greater than one who 
grows arrogant without understanding their 
own weakness.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Brian ran a great race too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Those who gathered at the Kikuka Sho today 
were simply stronger. That is all there is 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't just leave things like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Though the Classic Triple Crown is over. 
Though I missed the title of "Strongest 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Train me. Iron out every single 
weakness uncovered today."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Forge them, chip away the excess, and let 
everything fuel you. I want legs capable 
of carrying you to the victory you desire.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even now, other Umamusume are growing 
stronger. I'm sure Ama-san is too...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Because with you, I know I can become 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Narita Brian's Classic Triple 
Crown campaign came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target is the year-end Arima 
Kinen. Senior-class Umamusume, and Hishi 
Amazon, should be waiting there...!
